reason: Declares legacy browser bridge records and browser workspace request and snapshot shapes. BrowserWorkspaceView holds the selection and snapshot. The desktop BrowserWorkspaceManager owns tab changes.
Declares Cloud account status and credit response shapes. useCloudState owns account refresh and publication. The host native session port owns credential operations.
Declares configuration, plugin, workbench, voice and character transport shapes and type re-exports. Agent configuration routes and runtime services apply the changes.
Declares relationship graph queries and results, including candidate merge status. Agent relationship routes call the runtime RelationshipsService to propose, accept and reject merges.
Declares Steward status, transaction, signing and approval payloads and re-exports wallet types. client-wallet reads paginated approvals and sends approval and rejection commands.
Declares overlay metadata, context, lazy loader and launch and stop hook signatures. The overlay registry holds registrations. OverlayAppSurface in AppWindowRenderer orders the lifecycle hooks.
Declares balance, checkout, invoice, crypto and membership payloads. Cloud checkout verification and settlement handle credit changes. Invoice routes read stored records.
Declares registry request and response shapes and MCP status labels. Cloud registry routes call userMcpsService to publish and unpublish the stored entry.
Declares panel props, variants and expansion callback signatures. PagePanelCollapsibleSection owns uncontrolled expansion. The caller supplies controlled expansion.
Supplies fixed section IDs, aliases, labels and group order. settings-sections uses these literals to build its display registry. SettingsView owns the active section and route.
Declares the startup shell view union and retry callback. useStartupShellController selects the view from the startup coordinator phase and bootstrap state.
Declares login context, tenant configuration, view props and Auth SDK type re-exports. LoginProvider holds session, provider and tenant selection state and calls the Auth client.
Declares client patch records and browser storage and history interfaces. The desktop permissions, first-run reset and Cloud preference shims implement patch installation and restoration.
Declares startup client and service ports and native boot status observations. createStartupCoordinator and its phase handlers own readiness transitions and cancellation.
Declares view lifecycle phases, transition payloads and a fixed default retention policy. ViewLifecycleController owns transitions, retention timers and listeners.
Declares the continuous voice status labels. voice-session-state reduces client and server events and maps session phases to these labels for the voice client.
Declares widget slots, an action event name, widget props and sunset policy. WidgetHost dispatches actions and filters the Home grid using home-dismissal-store.
